QuestInfo.name: Donating to Henesys
QuestInfo.0: #p229#, the town clerk, seems to be looking for items needed to manage #m10001000#. Let's go see #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, requested a donation of #b30 #t4000004#s#k for #m10001000#. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I gathered the items requested by #p229#, the town clerk, and brought them to him. I'm glad I could contribute to the development of our town.

0.0: "We are looking for someone to donate #b30 #t4000004#s#k for the sake of #m10001000#. We will give a small gift prepared by the town to the resident who contributes.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Welcome, #h0#. What brings you by today? Wait... are you saying you'd like to donate #b30 #t4000004#s#k?

yes.0: Thank you so much! I have successfully received the #b30 #t4000004#s#k. I must let everyone know that #h0# has done so much for our town. I look forward to working with you again next time.

item.0: Welcome, #h0#. Are you interested in donating to the town? If so, you can gather #b30 #t4000004#s#k and bring them to me. I'll be counting on you!

level.0: Could you please speak to me again after you reach Level 12 or higher?
